title: Ice-age gray farm and granary with 13 tunnels in an L-shaped valley
place_text: L-shaped desert valley, western deserts (central Nevada)

tellings.quote: And in the mountain on the west, they'd cut 13 tunnels in the in the mountain on the west and they used them as a grainery.

plain: Back in the ice age, a race of gray aliens is said to have run a farm in an L-shaped desert valley in central Nevada, with thirteen tunnels cut into the mountain on the valley's west side for use as a granary. Charles Hall tells this. He says he spent three years with tall white aliens at Area 51, the secret US Air Force base in Nevada, and he speaks of the valley as a place he knows himself. If true, it would mean aliens farmed in the American desert long before people wrote history.
